findings.description: Critical: fresh-bundle recovery after cached-token expiry/revocation leaves the dead AppRole token on the hvac client. `_check_cached_token` / prior `ensure_session` set `self.client.token` to the expired or revoked session token; `_recover` then calls `_bootstrap`, which posts `/v1/sys/wrapping/lookup` and `sys.unwrap(token=...)` without clearing or replacing that client token. hvac always sends `X-Vault-Token` when `client.token` is set, and unwrap-with-body-token is third-party unwrap that requires a valid authorized client token—not a dead AppRole token (hvac: "Do not use the wrapping token in both locations"). Long-lived recovery therefore fails against real OpenBao even when a digest-distinct fresh bundle is present; unit tests mock adapter/unwrap so they do not catch this. This breaks CFG-07 / D3 fresh-bundle recovery after revocation or lease expiry.
findings.resolution: In `_bootstrap`, before wrapping lookup/unwrap, set `self.client.token` to the wrapping token and call `unwrap()` with no `token=` argument (wrapping token as client token only), or clear `self.client.token` and authenticate the wrapping endpoints solely as the wrapping token. Add a regression test that asserts the client token used for lookup/unwrap equals the wrapping token (or is unset), especially on the revoked-session recovery path.

findings.description: Nit: after a successful `lookup_self`, renewal still keys only off local `lease_expires_at`, ignoring the server `ttl` already fetched in `_check_cached_token`. If local expiry and server TTL diverge (clock skew, external renew), the adapter can skip renew while server TTL is already inside the 60s window, then force a fresh-bundle recovery moments later instead of renewing the still-valid periodic token.
findings.resolution: Prefer renew when `min(local_remaining, server_ttl) <= 60`, or update `lease_expires_at` from server TTL after lookup before applying the renew window.

findings.description: none: one-use bootstrap controls match the contracts: server-side wrapping `creation_path` is validated before unwrap (CFG-24), session cache stores `bootstrap_token_sha256`, and `_recover` refuses digest-equal consumed bundles before unwrap (CFG-05/CFG-07 / session-cache.schema.json).
findings.resolution: Keep the wrapping-lookup-before-unwrap and digest-gated recovery checks; fix finding 1 so recovery can actually exercise them against a live server.

findings.description: none: explicit vendor declarations and Docker packaging comply with D1/D6 for this package: `credential_vendors` plus required per-keyed-agent `vendor_credentials`, legacy `openbao_role_id` rejected, exact KV-v2 `{api_key}` reads, Dockerfile COPY of `packages/openbao-credentials` before `uv sync --locked`, and CI smoke import of `openbao_credentials`.
